## Purpose
Renders the right-hand deliverable surface for a live or reopened run: a tabbed panel (Preview / Steps / Files / Audit) that dispatches to the correct typed renderer (user stories, PPT, prototype, app builder) or, for any pipeline type with no bespoke renderer, a generic mimetype-dispatched fallback (HTML iframe, Markdown, zip bundle, or download prompt).

## Shape
- `PreviewPanel(props)` — the main export; owns tab state, the read-only "viewing an older revision-family version" override, and the run-header state derivation (gate/clarify/building/terminal/complete/idle).
- `FIRST_PARTY_RENDERERS` — a dispatch table keyed on the structural `renderType` (user_stories/ppt/prototype/app_builder), each entry rendering only if its first-party content is present; falls through to the generic path otherwise (UXFIX-04/D-21, "generic-primary + first-party routed entries").
- `GenericDeliverablePreview` — the mimetype-dispatched fallback: `text/html` → sandboxed iframe (`sandbox="allow-scripts"`, no `allow-same-origin`, a deliberate XSS mitigation per T-18-05), `text/markdown` → `MarkdownPreview`, zip → `AppBuilderIDEPreview`, anything else → a safe download button.
- `AppBuilderIDEPreview` / `parseAppBuilderFilesForIDE` — merges ` ```filename:` code blocks from all code-producing agent outputs plus the final output into a file tree for the IDE-style App Builder view.
- `DegradedRunAffordance` (exported) — the terminal-empty failed/cancelled/degraded state UI; explicitly shared with `WorkflowHistory`'s reopen surface so the live and history paths cannot visually diverge (INV-3).
- A renderer-switcher (`rendererOptions`, `renderRendererOverride`) lets the user manually force a specific typed or mimetype renderer on top of the primary auto-dispatch.

## Why this shape
Dispatch throughout is keyed on structural signals — declared mimetype, renderType, filename — never a workflow/agent name, a rule the code repeatedly cites as SC-001/INV-1; this is what lets an arbitrary custom pipeline's deliverable render safely without adding a new named branch.
